name: statusbox
description: A live status box above the Claude Code prompt (context, model, git, tokens, cost, rate limits), a side panel of sessions and agents, pasted-image previews, and desktop notifications

toasts.title: Desktop notifications
toasts.description: Show a desktop notification when Claude needs permission, finishes, compacts, or crosses an alert threshold

sounds.title: Notification sounds
sounds.description: Play a system sound with each alert

contextAlert.title: Context alert (%)
contextAlert.description: Alert once when the context window reaches this percentage; 0 turns it off

rateLimitAlert.title: Rate limit alert (%)
rateLimitAlert.description: Alert once per window when the 5-hour or 7-day rate limit reaches this percentage; 0 turns it off
